info.title: Bank Account Fraud Dataset Suite (NeurIPS 2022)
info.subtitle: Biased, Imbalanced, Dynamic Tabular Datasets for ML Evaluation.
info.userSpecifiedSources:
Each instance in the suite of datasets represents a synthetic, feature-engineered bank account
opening application in tabular format. These were generated using a CTGAN trained on a
real-world anonymized dataset for bank account opening fraud. There are no different types
of instances.
